purpose: page the right person for conditions that need action, and nobody for anything else
entry_criteria: Service level objectives or critical symptoms are defined
On-call rota and escalation path exist
Metrics and logs are available to alert on
procedure: Choose alerts that reflect user-visible symptoms or SLO burn, not every internal metric.
For each alert write severity, threshold, evaluation window, owner and a runbook link stating the first action.
Route by severity: page for urgent user impact, ticket for non-urgent.
Test each alert by triggering or replaying the condition in a safe environment.
Review alert volume weekly; remove or retune alerts that fire without action.
Record every change to alert rules in version control.
acceptance_criteria: Every page has an owner and a runbook with a first action
Each alert was tested at least once
Pages that required no action are tracked and reduced
validation_method: Test fire of each alert reaches the on-call person.

validation.command: promtool check rules alerts/*.yml   # example for Prometheus rules

validation.check: trigger the test alert and confirm the on-call device receives it within the target time

failure_modes.detection: More than half of pages need no action

failure_modes.mode: Routing sends to a team that no longer exists

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A page for 'error budget burn above 10x over one hour' links to a runbook that starts with checking the latest deployment. A test replay of last week's incident metrics fires the alert.
